meta.description: Premium and built-in appliance repair in Austin, including Sub-Zero. Experienced independent technicians, written pricing and a 90-day parts and labor warranty.

overview: Built-in and premium appliances need the right parts and patience. You get both, from an independent local team.

brandsBlock.intro: Choose your brand to see what we fix.

faq.q: Are you an authorized servicer for premium brands?
faq.a: No. We are an independent repair company, not affiliated with or authorized by any manufacturer, and we use OEM parts.
Parts usually cost more; you get the full price in writing before any work.

faqClosing: More questions? Our FAQ page covers scheduling and warranty.

closing.body: Independent, experienced and backed for 90 days.
